compute_topk_accuracy: compute top-k classification accuracy from JAX logits and 1D integer labels
compute_softmax_cross_entropy: compute softmax cross-entropy loss from logits and one-hot labels with mean or sum reduction
l2_normalize_tensor: l2 normalize a JAX tensor along a given axis with numerical stability
compute_l2_weight_regularizer: compute the L2 weight regularization scalar from a model params dictionary excluding biases and norm layers
compute_regression_loss: compute BYOL-style regression loss as squared distance between L2-normalized prediction and target vectors
